title: Youthful Tunisian Beef Shin Wrap
description: A briny and chewy Tunisian dish featuring beef shin in a mother sauce base, served in a ti leaf wrap, perfect for a energizing meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the beef shin pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste, harissa, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the pot and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Prepare the ti leaves by washing and trimming them to size.
Assemble the wraps by placing a portion of the beef mixture onto a ti leaf and serving immediately.
